scope: Miao Chapter 19 (pp. 615-670): the basic DNK model (households, Dixit-Stiglitz aggregation, Calvo pricing, price dispersion, the flexible-price equilibrium, the log-linearised system and its determinacy, Exercise 1), monetary policy design (efficient allocation, the quadratic welfare approximation, commitment, the timeless perspective and discretion, Exercise 2), fiscal stimulus at the zero lower bound (multipliers, duration, optimal government purchases, Exercises 3-5). The medium-scale model of section 19.4 is listed only.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 19
